title: Can I BEAT Mini Chess? (Rare Variant)
summary: Mini chess on chess.com (Minihouse): a 6x6 board with a reduced army, and captured pieces go to your inventory to be dropped back on the board (crazyhouse rules). 1-minute games; he pushes pawns, drops pieces with check and wins three games, discovering he cannot promote to a queen.
rules: 6x6 board, reduced army (no queen in setup per 3:46 'you can't promote to a queen' - inferred: Minihouse setup K, R, B, N + 6 pawns per side).
Captured pieces go to your hand and may be dropped on any empty square as a move (crazyhouse drops).
Pawns cannot be dropped on the first/last rank (inferred).
setup: chess.com Minihouse: e.g. 'rbnkbr/pppppp/6/6/PPPPPP/RBNKBR' - exact order not stated (inferred).
current_impl_issues: Current 'mini 6x6' lacks drops; should be Minihouse (6x6 + crazyhouse drops, no queen promotion).

current_impl.explain: A cut-down board with fewer pieces; pawns step one square and promote at the far edge. Checkmate the bot to win.
